summary: First-party English and Hindi discovery identified Rajasthan Revenue Department/Board of Revenue cadastral-map services, NIC BhuNaksha Rajasthan, Apna Khata and Rajdharaa Urban GIS. No bounded anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained, so no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and URLs, direct viewer requests, response outcomes, schema/CRS availability and scratch evidence are recorded in city-7440-jhunjhunu.json. BhuNaksha georef page timed out with normal TLS; documented REST menu routes also timed out. Rajdharaa citizenudh index returned HTTP 404. No login, credential, CAPTCHA bypass, private token or unsafe field request was used.

schemaAndCrs.fieldMapping: No live anonymous feature schema was returned; only public UI labels (district, tehsil, village, khasra number) were observed.

safeFieldAllowlist: canonical native parcel identifier if independently verified
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [28.1198887898694, 75.3915488181953] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
No exact-point or extent hit/miss was treated as evidence of citywide presence or absence.
No full parcel polygon was retained because no safe native identity and geometry response were obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account or certificate fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: BhuNaksha service availability was not verifiable during this attempt because requests timed out.
Rajdharaa's live route was removed/404, despite official indexed documentation.
State-level cadastral service evidence does not establish complete Jhunjhunu citywide coverage.
No independent serial reviewer qualification has occurred.
doNotInfer: A timeout, 404, login wall or unusable viewer is not evidence of parcel absence.
A state cadastral viewer is not proof of citywide geometry completeness.
A public workflow label is not a parcel schema or stable native identifier.
